newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MARSEILLE WIN 1-0, CHAMPIONS MONACO HELD AT HOME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARSEILLE WIN 1-0, CHAMPIONS MONACO HELD AT HOME.

text.p: France defender Laurent Blanc scored his third goal in two games to give Marseille a 1-0 home win over Nantes as champions Monaco were held 2-2 at home by promoted Chateauroux in the French first division on Friday.
Blanc curled a free kick over the Nantes wall and past the despairing dive of teenage goalkeeper Mickael Landreau to put his side joint top with a maximum six points.
Monaco, beaten 1-0 in their opening match, had to come from behind to secure a point after two goals by striker Didier Martel for last season's second division champions.
Metz, who beat Bordeaux 4-1 at home, are top of the table on goal difference after two rounds. Paris St Germain, 3-2 winners at Auxerre on Thursday, are second and Marseille third.
Bastia, who beat Guingamp 1-0, and promoted Toulouse, 1-0 winners at Cannes, also have a maximum six points.
